### Day 298: Acts 28:30–31
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-298-acts-28-3031.html
Passage: Acts 28:30-31
Points:
- Paul's remarkable perseverance through hardship was rooted in his deep passion for Christ.
- Settling into spiritual comfort risks missing out on the greater riches God offers.
- God's greatest blessings conform us to Christ rather than leave us comfortable.
- The Holy Spirit works through ordinary human lives when we remain receptive and yield to Him.
- Walking with and trusting God turns any believer's life into an ongoing spiritual adventure.
